topic: why holding a secret is exhausting - it's alone-time rumination, not the lying
title: You're Keeping 13 Secrets Right Now — Here's Why That's Exhausting You
description: The psychology of secrecy: research on secret-keeping suggests it's not the lying to people's faces that wears you down — it's the quiet moments alone when your mind keeps circling back to it. AI-narrated original commentary on the science behind why secrets feel heavy. #psychology #shorts

hook_candidates.text: Why does keeping a secret feel so much more exhausting than telling one lie?
Lying to someone's face isn't what makes secrets exhausting.
A psychologist once asked thousands of people to count every secret they were keeping — the number surprised even the researchers.

beats.text: We assume it's lying to people's faces that wears us down.
It's not — it's being **alone**, when your mind won't drop it.
That restless 2am feeling? That's your thirteen, **surfacing**. What's yours — tell me below.
